paite: "Zion tang a nuam lua a omte leh Samaria tang a bittak a omte leh Israel nam lian lak a inkuan mithupite tung agik hi!
heading: Israel Hihsiatna

paite: Kalneh ah hoh unla, en un; huai a kipan in Hamath kho thupi ah hoh un; Philistia gam Gath ah paisuk unla; hiai gamte sang in noute na hoihzaw uhia? Nou gam sang in agam uh azazaw a hia?
Nou ni hoih lou gamlapi a koih leh hiamgam tunna naihsakte aw,
saiha lupna a lum a, atutphah sau tungte ua kizia a, belamhon lak a belamnoute leh bawnghonte lak a kipan bawngtuaite ne a;
David bang a kaihging tumtum a, lasak ding na bawlbawl uh;
belhbu lian a uain dawn a, sathau hoihpen a kinuhte mah; himahleh Joseph haksatna ziak in alungkham kei uhi.
Huchi in tua sal dia pai masate toh sal in apai ding ua, nuam sa a kiziate nopsakna lakmang in a-om ding hi."
TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Toupa PATHIAN in amah-le-amah kilou in akichiam a, "Jakob kisaktheihna ka kih a, akumpipa' inn te ka mudah a; huaiziak in khua leh asung a om tengteng ka mansak sin ahi.”
Hichi ahong hi ding a, inn khat a mi sawm a-omleh asi vek ding uhi.

Huan vui ding a thaunilh, misite tanau, amaute halpa ngei in insung a kipan a aguh lakhe ding in, insung tawng pen a mi om kiang ah, "Na kiang ah kuahiam midang a-om lai uhia?" achih a, ama'n, "Om lou,” achihleh; ama'n, "Dai sipsip in! TOUPA min i lou ding uh ahi ngal kei a," achi ding hi.
Ngai dih ua, TOUPA'N thu apeta hi; inn lian achim lemlum ding a, inn neu leng akhangkham ik-iak ding hi.
Sakolte suangpi tung ah atai ding ua hia? Huai ah mi'n bawng in lei alet ding ua hia? Noute'n vaihawmna lah gu na suaksak ua diktatna gah singkha na suaksak uh.
Nou thil bangmah lou tung a kipak a, i hatna in ahi kei maw kiite i lak ua? chite aw.
"En dih ua, Aw Israel inkote aw, nou hon dou ding in nam ka dingkhesak ding a; huan Hamath khomual a kipan in Arabah lui tan in nou ahon engbawl ding uh," TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian in achita hi.
